description: The operator surfaces that read/write the shared tergum.toml admin list and drive the new RPCs: the server CLI command group `tergum admin-client {add,remove,list}`, the client-side helper `tergum client fingerprint`, the admin cross-client restore CLI mode in `tergum restore`, and the Web UI admin-clients editor backed by the same tergum.toml with a synchronous policy Reload. Depends on FEAT-002 (callerIsAdmin + RestoreToTarget enforcement, the WithAdminPolicy option) and FEAT-001 (config helpers, registry SPKI). Grounded in design.md sections 4.1, 4.2, 5.4, 6, 7.
steps: cmd/client.go: parameterize `openRegistry()` to `openRegistry(cmdName string)` so the role-guard error reads `'tergum <cmdName>' commands are only available on server or hybrid nodes`; update the existing client callers (runClientSetDisabled, runClientList, runClientStatus) to pass "client".

cmd/admin_client.go (new) registered via rootCmd.AddCommand(newAdminClientCmd()) in cmd/root.go: a top-level `admin-client` group (NOT a subcommand of the existing `admin` UI launcher, which stays untouched) with add/remove/list, mirroring the cmd/client.go + cmd/retention.go style, honoring global --config/--json/--dry-run and the server/hybrid-only guard via openRegistry("admin-client").

cmd/admin_client.go add <name> (flags --fingerprint, --yes): --fingerprint path TrimSpace+ToLower, validate ^[0-9a-f]{64}$, use directly (trusted, no prompt); name path look up registry.GetClient(name).SPKIFingerprint, if present print the full 64-hex fingerprint + last-seen + machine-id + hostname and require --yes (non-interactive) or an interactive y/N confirm before writing; if the client never connected (no fingerprint) error with guidance to connect once then re-run with --yes or pass --fingerprint. Then cfg.AddAdminClient(name, fp), writeConfigTOML (honor --config), printOutput({client,fingerprint,status}); emit the observe INFO event=admin_client_added. --dry-run prints the resolved preview and writes nothing.

cmd/admin_client.go remove <name> (flag --fingerprint): cfg.RemoveAdminClientByName (or ByFingerprint when --fingerprint given), report unchanged if nothing matched, writeConfigTOML; emit INFO event=admin_client_removed. No confirmation needed (removal only reduces privilege).

cmd/admin_client.go list: load the config admin list, cross-reference the registry for current online status/last-known name; --json emits an array of {name, fingerprint, status} with the FULL fingerprint; human output is a tabwriter table NAME/FINGERPRINT/STATUS showing the full 64-hex fingerprint (not truncated), styled like client list.

cmd/client.go (or a small new subcommand): add `tergum client fingerprint` available on ANY node role — connection.LoadClientTLS(cfg) -> x509.ParseCertificate(tlsCfg.Certificates[0].Certificate[0]) -> sha256.Sum256(leaf.RawSubjectPublicKeyInfo) -> hex.EncodeToString (lowercase); print the fingerprint (and honor --json). This avoids the nil tls.Certificate.Leaf panic and is byte-identical to the server's clientSPKIFromContext.

cmd/restore.go: in runRestore add an early branch immediately after flag parsing and the existing argument-validation checks (--target requires --client; mutually-exclusive query) and BEFORE the dbPath/os.Stat/db.NewRepository/loadRestoreMasterKey/NewDataSource block: `if targetClient != "" && clientID != "" && cfg.Node.Role == "client" { if listOnly { return error('--list is not supported in admin cross-client mode') }; return runAdminRemoteRestore(cfg, clientID, targetClient, query, backupID, dest) }`. Narrow the existing 'the --client flag cannot be used on a client node' error so it fires only when targetClient == "".

cmd/restore.go: add `runAdminRemoteRestore(cfg, sourceA, targetB, query, backupID, dest string) error` that dials the server command channel (connection.LoadClientTLS(cfg) + grpcpkg.Connect(ctx, cfg.Server.Address, cfg.Server.CommandPort, cfg.Server.DataPort, tlsCfg) + client.SetClientID), calls client.RestoreToTarget with the flag->field mapping (SourceClientId=--client, TargetClientId=--target, Query=collapsed query, BackupId=--backup-id, Dest=--dest), and surfaces errors as-is (PermissionDenied/Unimplemented/ConfigError) and printOutput the counts on success. An optional shared helper dialServerCommandClient(cfg) may wrap the dial.

internal/webui/admin_client_settings.go (new) registered on the server mux next to handleAPIConfigSettings: GET /api/admin-clients (config.Load(s.configPath) -> cfg.Admin.Clients annotated with registry online-status), POST /api/admin-clients ({name} + optional {fingerprint}; resolve name->fingerprint via the registry like the CLI add, TrimSpace+ToLower any raw fingerprint, cfg.AddAdminClient, write back via the config_settings.go load->mutate->toml.Encode->O_WRONLY|O_CREATE|O_TRUNC->syncInMemoryConfig pattern, update s.fullCfg), DELETE (or POST with an action field) /api/admin-clients ({name}/{fingerprint} -> cfg.RemoveAdminClientBy... -> write back).

internal/webui/admin_client_settings.go: after writing tergum.toml and updating s.fullCfg, each mutating handler (add and remove) calls s.adminPolicy.Reload() synchronously for immediate revocation; a Reload error is logged WARN and does not fail the request; skip the poke when s.adminPolicy is nil.

internal/webui/templates/config.html (and any partial/fragment it uses): add an admin-clients section following the existing HTMX/Alpine.js pattern — a list of current admin clients each showing the FULL 64-hex fingerprint with a remove button, and an add form with a client-name selector populated from the registry plus a raw-fingerprint input (trusted path). The add flow must show the resolved fingerprint + last-seen/machine-id and require an explicit confirm click before POSTing (the UI equivalent of --yes). No new JS framework.
acceptance_criteria: `go test ./cmd/...` passes including new tests: admin-client add/remove/list against a temp config + temp registry DB assert the written [[admin.clients]] content and --json output; the role guard rejects a client node with a message naming 'admin-client'; --dry-run writes nothing; `client fingerprint` prints a 64-hex lowercase string.

`go test ./internal/webui/...` passes including handler tests: a POST /api/admin-clients writes [[admin.clients]] to tergum.toml and config.Load sees the entry; a DELETE removes it; the mutating handlers invoke adminPolicy.Reload().
`go build ./...` compiles; `tergum admin` (bare UI launcher) behavior is unchanged.
On a client node, `tergum restore --client A --target B` takes the admin remote branch (no local source-DB/key setup) and calls RestoreToTarget; `--list` in that mode is rejected with a clear error.
A fingerprint added via the Web UI is listed by `tergum admin-client list` and vice versa (same tergum.toml).
findings:
Implemented and committed on feature/admin-clients. Operator surfaces for the admin-client capability.

CLI (cmd/):
- openRegistry() is now openRegistry(cmdName string); the role-guard error reads 'tergum <cmdName> commands are only available on server or hybrid nodes'. All three existing client callers (runClientSetDisabled, runClientList, runClientStatus) pass "client"; admin-client callers pass "admin-client".
- cmd/client.go: new `tergum client fingerprint` subcommand (newClientFingerprintCmd/runClientFingerprint), available on ANY node role. Loads TLS via connection.LoadClientTLS, parses the leaf with x509.ParseCertificate(tlsCfg.Certificates[0].Certificate[0]) (avoids the nil tls.Certificate.Leaf panic), sha256.Sum256(leaf.RawSubjectPublicKeyInfo), lowercase hex. Honors --json ({"fingerprint":...}). Byte-identical to the server's clientSPKIFromContext.
- cmd/admin_client.go (NEW), registered in cmd/root.go via rootCmd.AddCommand(newAdminClientCmd()) as a TOP-LEVEL `admin-client` group (the bare `admin` UI launcher in cmd/admin.go is untouched). Subcommands add/remove/list; all go through openRegistry("admin-client") for the server/hybrid guard and honor global --config/--json/--dry-run.
  * add <name> --fingerprint --yes: --fingerprint path TrimSpace+ToLower, validates ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ (package var adminClientFingerprintRe), used directly (trusted, no prompt). Name path looks up reg.GetClient(name).SPKIFingerprint; if present prints full fingerprint + last-seen + machine-id + hostname and requires --yes or an interactive y/N; if no recorded fingerprint, errors with guidance to connect once then re-run with --yes or pass --fingerprint. Writes via cfg.AddAdminClient + writeConfigTOML(resolveConfigPath()), prints {client,fingerprint,status}, emits observe.Logger("admin-client") INFO event=admin_client_added. --dry-run prints the preview and writes nothing. Re-adding an existing fingerprint reports status=unchanged and does not rewrite.
  * remove <name> --fingerprint: cfg.RemoveAdminClientByFingerprint when --fingerprint given else RemoveAdminClientByName; reports status=unchanged (no error) if nothing matched; writeConfigTOML; INFO event=admin_client_removed. No confirmation.
  * list: loads config admin list, cross-references the registry by SPKI fingerprint for live status; --json emits array of {name,fingerprint,status} with FULL fingerprint; human output is a tabwriter NAME/FINGERPRINT/STATUS table with the full 64-hex fingerprint. Entries with no matching live client show status=offline.
  * helper resolveConfigPath() returns cfgFile or config.DefaultConfigPath().
- cmd/restore.go: runRestore gained an early admin branch immediately after flag/arg validation and BEFORE the dbPath/os.Stat/NewRepository/key/NewDataSource block: `if targetClient != "" && clientID != "" && cfg.Node.Role == "client" { if listOnly -> error('--list is not supported in admin cross-client mode'); return runAdminRemoteRestore(cfg, clientID, targetClient, query, backupID, dest) }`. The existing 'the --client flag cannot be used on a client node' guard was narrowed to fire only when targetClient == "". New runAdminRemoteRestore(cfg, sourceA, targetB, query, backupID, dest string) error dials the server command channel via connection.LoadClientTLS + grpcpkg.Connect(ctx, cfg.Server.Address, cfg.Server.CommandPort, cfg.Server.DataPort, tlsCfg) + client.SetClientID(clientID), calls client.RestoreToTarget with SourceClientId=--client, TargetClientId=--target, Query, BackupId, Dest, surfaces errors as-is (server maps PermissionDenied/Unimplemented/ConfigError), and printOutput the counts on success.

WEB UI (internal/webui/):
- admin_client_settings.go (NEW): handleAPIAdminClients dispatches GET/POST/DELETE on /api/admin-clients, registered on the authed mux in server.go next to handleAPIConfigSettings. GET loads config.Load(s.configPath), annotates each cfg.Admin.Clients entry with live status from the registry (adminFingerprintStatus), returns {clients:[{name,fingerprint,status}]}. POST decodes {name, fingerprint?}: raw fingerprint is TrimSpace+ToLower and used directly; name-only resolves via s.clientRegistry.GetClient(name).SPKIFingerprint; then cfg.AddAdminClient -> writeAdminConfig (load->mutate already done in-handler; writes via os.OpenFile O_WRONLY|O_CREATE|O_TRUNC + toml.Encode and sets s.fullCfg.Admin). DELETE decodes {name?,fingerprint?} -> RemoveAdminClientByFingerprint/ByName -> writeAdminConfig; reports status=unchanged when nothing matched. Both mutating handlers call s.reloadAdminPolicy() (synchronous s.adminPolicy.Reload(); nil-policy skipped; Reload error logged WARN, does not fail the request).
- templates/config.html: added an Admin Clients section (Alpine.js adminClientsManager, no new JS framework) with a list showing the FULL 64-hex fingerprint + status and a Remove button, and an add form (name selector + optional raw-fingerprint input). A name-only add shows a confirm prompt before POSTing (UI equivalent of --yes); a raw-fingerprint add is the trusted path and posts directly.

NO server-side authorization lives in the UI/CLI — they are convenience front-ends; enforcement remains in internal/grpc/command_server.go (FEAT-002). The Reload() poke is purely for immediate revocation latency.

TESTS:
- cmd/admin_client_test.go: add --fingerprint writes [[admin.clients]] + asserts TOML/content; UPPERCASE+padded fingerprint normalized to canonical lowercase; bad fingerprint errors; registry-resolved add (--yes); unknown client errors; --dry-run writes nothing; remove by name; remove by fingerprint; remove-unchanged no error; list; role guard on a client node errors with a message naming 'admin-client'; `client fingerprint` prints a 64-hex lowercase string (generates real Ed25519 certs via internal/tls Manager.GenerateCerts).
- internal/webui/admin_client_settings_test.go: POST writes [[admin.clients]] and config.Load sees it + asserts adminPolicy.Reload() called once; name-only POST resolves via a fake registry; DELETE removes and asserts a second Reload(); GET returns the entry with online status. Uses a fakeAdminPolicy (records Reload calls) and a fakeRegistry implementing ClientRegistry.

VERIFICATION: `go build ./...`, `make build`, `make lint` (go vet) all pass. `go test ./internal/webui/...` passes fully. `go test ./cmd/...` passes for all new tests; the only cmd failures are the two PRE-EXISTING setup tests (TestSetupGenerateCertsFlag, TestInteractiveSetupExistingConfig) that fail identically on the untouched main worktree (unrelated to this feature — confirmed by running them on /Users/ricardowagemaker/Programming/tergum).

MERGE/REVIEW NOTES: resolveConfigPath() in cmd/admin_client.go is the single source of the config path for the admin-client group; if a future feature needs the same for other config-mutating CLI commands, promote it. The admin-client list status mapping treats any registry client sharing the stored fingerprint as the live identity; a client that has never connected shows 'offline'. The bare `tergum admin` launcher (cmd/admin.go) was intentionally left untouched per the task.
